confirmations.answer: the brachot followed by threefold blessing and until the end of eilu dvarim should move conditionally on the German rite. In the German rite, after רופא כל בשר ומפליא לעשות comes אלהי נשמה; in every other rite, birchot hatorah...eilu dvarim are in between. In the German rite, they change position. The expanded edition still needs a conditional on rite
confirmations.resolution: Use opensiddur:rite/german directly. Move all three Torah blessings, Numbers6:24–26 and EluDevarim as one block. Exactly one ElohaiNeshamah and one complete block in each definite rite. Undefined rite retains labeled alternatives.
